question.title: Who will win the 2026 World Chess Championship?
question.description:
The [FIDE World Championship Match 2026](https://calendar.fide.com/calendar.php?id=19098) is the the pinnacle of the FIDE World Championship Cycle. The Match will be between reigning World Champion **Gukesh Dommaraju** and Challenger **Javokhir Sindarov** and will take place in Geneva, Switzerland, from November 25 to December 15, 2026.

[The Match](https://www.fide.com/geneva-to-host-fide-world-championship-match-2026/) was determined in April 2026.

> As reigning champion, Gukesh will defend the crown he won in Singapore in December 2024. At the age of 18, he defeated China’s Ding Liren, securing victory in the fourteenth and final classical game to become the 18th World Champion and the youngest player ever to hold the title.
>  
> Sindarov earned his opportunity to challenge for the crown by winning the FIDE Candidates Tournament 2026 in Cyprus. The Uzbek grandmaster secured first place with a round to spare, adding another major achievement to his victory at the 2025 FIDE World Cup.

The Match will consist of 14 classical games. The first player to score 7½ points will win, with no further games played once that score has been reached. If the score is tied after all 14 classical games, tiebreaks will determine the champion.
question.resolution_criteria: This question will resolve as the winner of the 2026 World Chess Championship, according to official results announced by [FIDE](https://www.fide.com/news).
question.fine_print:
If Gukesh Dommaraju forfeits the match, this question will resolve as **Javokhir Sindarov**. If Javokhir Sindarov forfeits the match the question will resolve as **Gukesh Dommaraju**.

If the match is cancelled or postponed to after December 31, 2026, this question will be **annulled**.
